team.heading: Not our first rodeo: 40+ years of digital experience

daniel.name: Daniel de Vos
daniel.description: Brings the knowledge of large companies to SMEs. He makes unclear data and smart technology directly workable for your organization — the foundation under both AI transformation and custom software. He specializes in quickly testing solutions and eliminating internal red tape.

xennith.name: Xennith Oosterveer
xennith.description: Senior generalist and the bridge between technology and your daily practice. With more than a decade of strategic experience, he translates complex challenges into a clear, step-by-step plan — whether that's an AI transformation or a custom tool. His background in web and commerce is why he knows the data and systems layer underneath so well. The result: immediate time savings and an efficient way of working, so you can grow without the overhead of a large agency.

kevin.name: Kevin
kevin.description: An entrepreneur and senior generalist who thinks along and gets stuck in. From building online brands he knows how customers, data and systems connect — and he puts that knowledge to work in AI transformation and custom tools. He combines data, psychology and technology, with the customer as the starting point and sustainable, measurable growth as the goal.
